tagline.es: Apila piezas en la balanza sin que se caigan, en modo fácil o difícil.
tagline.en: Stack pieces on the scale without letting them fall, in easy or hard mode.
tagline.pt: Empilhe peças na balança sem deixá-las cair, no modo fácil ou difícil.

canonExceptions.why: Two levels, each the owner's prototype brought whole from another tool and kept untouched (docs/games/wobbles.md): easy/ (2D) and hard/ (3D), pages of their own with their code inline, behind a cover that follows the canons. So there is no engine.js or engine.test.mjs: the physics lives in each level's page.
